title: Raise the Notta-inspired UI to product quality
summary: Polish the desktop and responsive experience while making every processing, empty, failure, retry, and completion state truthful.
acceptanceCriteria: Recording, upload, transcript, notes, search, export, and course flows are usable at desktop and tablet widths.
No control reports success before its underlying operation succeeds.
Keyboard navigation, visible focus, labels, and contrast meet the agreed accessibility baseline.
The implementation uses original branding and assets while following the requested workflow.
Visual regression screenshots cover the dashboard, recording, transcript, AI notes, errors, and batch upload.
npm run check and npm run build pass.
